youtube_title: Mexico 2-3 England: Bellingham's Brace Survives Red Card Chaos (World Cup R16)
youtube_description: Jude Bellingham scores twice inside two minutes, then England have to defend the lead a man down for 36 minutes after Jarell Quansah's red card. Julian Quinones and a Raul Jimenez penalty give Mexico a fighting chance, but England hold on 3-2 to reach the quarterfinal against Norway — while Mexico's wait for a first World Cup quarterfinal since 1986 goes on. #WorldCup2026 #England #Mexico #RoundOf16
